Hi Anna — thanks, this is perfect context. I put together a first-pass MAP and an acceptance-test suite (attached) that maps each milestone to a measurable test. Summary below; full details in ORB-MAP-v1.xlsx and acceptance-test-suite.md (attached).

Quick summary (POC duration: 4 weeks):
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment provisioning (VPC peering + KMS config). Deliverable: env checklist + access matrix.
- Week 1: Baseline inference tests (p50/p95 under 10 concurrent sessions). Acceptance: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 420ms for <1024 token sequences.
- Week 2: Quality conformance run (seed clinical prompt pack, 200 queries). Acceptance: >= 92% recall on key-entity extraction tasks; hallucination rate <= 2% measured via blind adjudication.
- Week 3: Scale & failover (10 -> 50 concurrent sessions smoke). Acceptance: sustained throughput with <1% error rate; KV cache warmup time < 5s for streaming calls.
- Final gate: Business sign-off if all acceptance tests pass and no critical security findings.

Decision gates & rollback: we define stop conditions at each gate (e.g., p95 > 2x target OR hallucination > 5% OR inability to meet data residency controls). If any stop condition is met, we pause and run a remediation sprint (3 business days) before re-test.

Artifacts we will deliver:
- Weekly test reports (latency/throughput/quality)
- Sample audit logs + S3 link with redacted traces
- Acceptance test runbook & raw evaluation dataset
- Short runbook for on-call (escalation matrix)

I'm looping in Marissa (APPLIED ML) and Ben (Solutions) to enumerate the technical tests and procurement checklist. Will iterate quickly on the MAP.

Thanks,

Tagging on with the technical acceptance tests we need to run. I've added the below tests into acceptance-test-suite.md; summary here so procurement/engineering can see quick pass/fail criteria.

Quality & conformance tests (week 2)
- Entity extraction F1 on labeled set (200 queries): pass if F1 >= 0.88; warn if 0.80-0.88; fail if <0.80.
- Hallucination audit: blind adjudication of 200 outputs; pass if <=2% hallucination, fail if >5%.
- Safety filters: verify deterministic filter triggers on 500 edge-cases; pass if false-negative <=1%.

Performance tests (week 1 & 3)
- Cold-start latency: measure first-token latency across 100 cold sessions; pass if median < 200ms.
- Continuous streaming latency: p50/p95 as Priyom defined.
- Throughput resiliency: increase concurrency in steps (10, 20, 35, 50) and measure error rate and latency drift; fail if error rate >1.5% at any step.

Ops & compliance checks
- Audit log sampling: deliver 30 days of sampled logs for review (redacted).
- Key management and rotation verification: KMS integration test pass.
- Data residency: proof of storage region configured for OrbitMed assets (screenshot + policy doc).

Acceptance criteria are binary where possible; if we land in a warn band we'll propose targeted mitigations and a 72-hour remediation window.

Marissa
